constitution.1T: An Impressum is the public operator interface that requires identity, physical address, direct contact and continuing accountability together.

4F.wxy: Identity, address and accountability preserve attributable operation without yet supplying a direct electronic contact.
4F.wxz: Identity, address and contact form a reachable provider surface without yet stating how responsibility persists over time.
4F.wzy: Identity, contact and accountability permit responsive responsibility without yet grounding a physical service address.
4F.xzy: Address, contact and accountability preserve reachability over time without independently naming who the operator is.

6E.wx: Public operator identity remains attributable through a stable service address.
6E.wy: Named operation can remain accountable as the site continues to change.
6E.wz: Operator identity becomes directly reachable rather than merely named.
6E.xy: Stable addressability lets accountability remain attached to the same operator through site evolution.
6E.xz: A physical service address and electronic contact jointly make the operator reachable.
6E.zy: Direct communication lets accountability answer concrete external concerns.
